# CW-WAM

CW-WAM: A Structured Contact-Wrench World Action Model for Force-Sensitive Manipulation

**2026-10-21 · Preprint · Ant Group**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30117)** · [Project](https://cw-wam-project.github.io/)

A world-action model predicts paired motion and contact wrench, using wrench history and an admittance controller for force-sensitive execution.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/cw-wam-policy.webp" width="760" alt="Fig. 2: CW-WAM jointly predicts video, motion, and wrench from visual observations, language, robot state, and interaction history. Paired motion–wrench tokens capture recent interactions, while long-term wrench memory retains earlier contact information. Pair-causal attention links each future wrench to its paired action and earlier pairs. The model jointly denoises the three streams using separate prediction heads. Predicted motion and wrench trajectories provide paired references for robot co"/>

**Scope and qualifications**

- RealSense D405/D455 cameras supply three RGB views here; a depth sensor model does not establish a depth-policy input.
- 20 Hz admittance is controller execution, not WAM-query rate; wrist F/T is not skin tactile.
